name: TFM2 Patch Balance Improvement
summary: Adds safety guards for apply preflight and save normalizer apply mode.
notes: Checks exe compatibility before modifying bundle.game_data, preventing partial bundle-only application on unsupported executables.
Save normalizer apply mode now requires at least one save backup before apply.flag is created.
Normalizer install, uninstall, enable, disable, and apply flag changes now stop when TeamfightManager2.exe is running.
